newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up amid uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up amid uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates surged on Thursday amid uncertainty about the status of liquidity in the system, dealers said.
"Uncertainty played havoc with overnight rates once again," a dealer at KASB & Co said. He said borrowers managed to strike early deals at 15 percent but later rates rose to 18 percent.

"At the close banks were seen borrowing at 19 and 20 percent," the dealer said. Uncertainty about liquidity hit one-week offers and no deals were reported as bids and offers remained unmatched, he said.
